author: Noema III
title: DSConv-PM v5g — Dilated DSConv + global reverse augmentation and bi-reverse eval
abstract: Global variant of v5: dilated depthwise-separable conv stack (dilations [1,2,4,8,16,16]) with power-mean pooling and residual scaling. Training-time reverse augmentation and eval-time bi-directional averaging are enabled for all datasets.
